summary: Crash after attempting to move item from off-hand in Creative inventory
description: A crash is caused when trying to offhand an item in the creative inventory after attempting to do so in the search tab Steps to reproduce: - Have an item in your off-hand in creative mode - Open inventory and go to the Search tab - Use the off-hand key to try and put the item in your off-hand into the hotbar (stopped as the search box takes priority) - Change back to the Survival Inventory tab, and then press the off-hand key again without hovering cursor over any inventory slots or: - Have an item in your off-hand in creative mode - Hover over any empty slot in a tab other than Survival Inventory - Select the Survival Inventory tab, and then press the off-hand key without hovering cursor over any inventory slots As far as I can tell (Not a programmer or anything, didn t look at code, just from my small testing) this happens because the offhand hotkey when pressed tries to put the item in your offhand into the last inventory slot that you had "selected" (hovered over) with your cursor. When you try to use the offhand hotkey when under the search tab, the search box takes priority and types instead of allowing you to offhand, making it the last selected inventory "slot" (I believe,) when you change back to your player inventory tab, there s no textbox anymore, so when you try to use the hotkey again, the game crashes as there s no "last selected" slot to offhand to (or maybe because it tries to offhand to the textbox? I dunno I m not a programmer) Simply hovering over an inventory slot after swapping to the player inventory before using the offhand hotkey will prevent the crash and allow the hotkey to work as normal.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft and enter a Creative world with default settings.
2. Ensure you have an item in your off-hand.
3. Open your inventory and navigate to the Search tab.
4. Attempt to use the off-hand key to place the item from your off-hand into the hotbar.
5. Change back to the Survival Inventory tab.
6. Without hovering your cursor over any inventory slots, press the off-hand key again.
7. Observe that the game crashes.
Observed Behavior: The issue arises when a player attempts to use the off-hand key to move an item from their off-hand into the hotbar while in the Creative inventory, specifically after having interacted with the Search tab. The crash occurs because, while in the Search tab, the off-hand key does not function as intended due to the search box taking priority, resulting in the game interpreting the last active inventory slot as the search box rather than a valid inventory slot. When the player switches back to the Survival Inventory tab and presses the off-hand key again without having the cursor over any inventory slots, the game crashes since there is no valid last selected slot to target. This behavior can also be replicated by hovering over an empty slot in any tab other than the Survival Inventory, selecting the Survival tab, and then pressing the off-hand key without placing the cursor over an inventory slot. To avoid the crash, players can simply hover over an inventory slot after switching back to the player inventory before using the off-hand key, which allows the hotkey to function normally without causing a crash.
Expected Behavior: When attempting to move an item from the off-hand in Creative mode, pressing the off-hand key while in the Survival Inventory tab should successfully place the item into the player's off-hand without causing a crash. The game should recognize the last selected inventory slot correctly, allowing the item to be transferred smoothly, regardless of prior interactions with the search tab. Hovering over any inventory slot before using the off-hand key should not be necessary for this action to function properly.
